subject: DPA and HIPAA scoping + SCCs — execution & signature plan (HealthCloud)
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@healthcloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@healthcloud.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: DPA next steps + HIPAA scope for onboarding

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal has a couple of asks before we can move to signature:
- Finalized DPA with our HIPAA addendum (we’re a covered entity).
- SCCs attached and signed for EU data flows (we have some EU-based patients).
- SOC 2 Type II report summary and timeline for evidence (SOC auditor will request logs).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept our HIPAA addendum (we highlighted a few items around breach notification timelines and BAA obligations) or if you prefer to incorporate equivalent language into your standard DPA? Also, can we do signature via DocuSign next week?

Attaching our standard HIPAA addendum and SCCs. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through redlines.

Thanks,
Emma Lopez
Sr. Contracts Manager | HealthCloud
emma@healthcloud.com

Attachments: HealthCloud_HIPAA_Addendum.pdf, HealthCloud_SCCs.zip

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA next steps + HIPAA scope for onboarding

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers:
- We can accept most of the HIPAA addendum but need to review two items (breach notification timeline and forensic access clause).
- We already have SCCs-ready language; I will attach our suggested wording.
- SOC 2 Type II summary: I’ve attached our latest summary and can provide the full report under NDA — we usually provide it to procurement during contracting.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll circulate a redline of your HIPAA addendum + our DPA (internal review today).
2) Legal (Monica) and Security (Vivek) will confirm the breach timeline/forensics response by Monday.
3) If acceptable, I’ll send a DocuSign envelope for signature (we prefer DocuSign for audit trail).

Would you be available for a 30-min sync on Mon 16th at 10am PT? If so I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: DPA next steps — redline plan

All —

I reviewed HealthCloud's HIPAA addendum and SCCs. Quick notes:
- Breach notification: their requested 24-hour notification window is aggressive; industry standard is 72 hours. We can accept 48 hours with an escalation clause for critical incidents.
- Forensics & access: they requested live forensic access to infra logs; propose scoped read-only access and joint incident response team.
- SCCs: they added a custom subprocessor list; we should confirm we can map it to our current subprocessors (will require update to our registry).

I’ll create a consolidated redline (track changes) against our standard DPA and the HIPAA addendum — flagging exceptions we need exec approval on. Also recommend we include a statement that SOC 2 evidence will be provided under standard NDA channel.

Monica
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlined_SCCs_20260213.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA next steps — security review

Monica —

Security notes after quick review:
- We can commit to 48-hour initial notification for confirmed breaches; full investigation updates within 7 days.
- Forensic access: provide scoped, read-only access to relevant log slices and a secure SFTP for pulled artifacts; disallow live console access.
- SOC 2: our 2025 Type II covers relevant controls. We’ll provide the auditor summary (attached) and can prepare the additional logs under NDA.

If legal is comfortable with those concessions, we can proceed to signature. No technical blockers.

Vivek
Head of Security | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-2025-summary.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: finalize redlines & exec approval ask

Team —

Thanks for the reviews. Monica, please proceed with the consolidated redline using the 48-hour notification + scoped forensic access language. Mark any clause that needs VP exec sign-off (we may need to route a minor credit if they insist on 24 hours).

I’ll schedule the customer sync for Mon 16th 10am PT (short notice — Emma said she’s available). After the call, I’ll push the DocuSign envelope.

Checklist for post-call:
- Final DPA (docx) attached to DocuSign.
- SCCs as addendum (pdf).
- Link to SOC 2 summary in DocuSign comments and note NDA requirement for full report.
- HubSpot deal updated and owner set to Dylan Brooks (deal HC-2026-137).

If we get a hard ask for 24-hour notification, I want to know acceptable credit range before I commit on the call.

Dylan

Appreciate the patience. Attached is the consolidated redline: HealthCloud_DPA_redline_20260216.docx and the SCCs addendum. Per our call and internal review we agreed to:

- Scoped, read-only forensic access to logs and a secure transfer mechanism for artifacts (no live console access).
- SOC 2 Type II summary attached; full report available under NDA.

Please sign when convenient and let me know if you need any changes before signature. If Contracts needs a countersignature order change, flag it here and I’ll escalate to Monica.

- Once signed, Legal will update our subprocessors registry to reflect HealthCloud mappings.
- Security will prepare the SOC 2 evidence bundle and a short onboarding checklist for your team.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
